# Webinar & Event Programs

`webinar-and-event-programs` · v1.0.0 · Execute · Growth, Retention & RevOps
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/webinar-and-event-programs/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** How many registrations does this event need to hit its pipeline target, and was the last one worth running again?

**Inputs:** The pipeline the event must create, your average opportunity value, your own rates for meetings to opportunities, attendees to meetings and registrations to attendance, the registrations you can realistically reach, and every cost including people time; the run-of-show items done; afterwards registrations, live and on-demand attendance, meetings, opportunities, pipeline, your win rate, cost and when the first follow-up went out

**Output:** The room the target needs - opportunities, meetings, attendees, registrations - with cost per each, the weakest step, and a feasible, stretch or not-feasible call; the run-of-show items still missing; and a repeat, change, stop or too-early verdict on expected revenue against cost

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill webinar-and-event-programs`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/webinar-and-event-programs/resources/event-program.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/webinar-and-event-programs/resources/event-program.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: not recorded yet.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- The plan uses only your conversion rates and has no defaults. Borrowed rates make the room size a guess; label them as assumptions.
- Without a win rate the verdict uses pipeline against cost, which reads higher than expected revenue and makes a repeat easier. A misspelled winRate falls back to this, with only a note.
- The 0.5 and 1.0 reach bands, the 3x target, the five-meeting floor and the 24-hour follow-up rule are engine rules, not benchmarks.
- Read too soon, the result undercounts: meetings take three to six weeks to become opportunities. Cost is only complete if people time is in it.

**Review before acting:** The marketing owner confirms the rates come from past events and that cost includes people time. The sales lead confirms meeting, opportunity and pipeline counts from the CRM before the repeat, change or stop call.
